premises.text: Robot innovation is now constrained by expensive complex hardware/actuators rather than brains, sensors, or software
premises.evidence_span: robots are no longer constrained by these parts. They're instead constrained by the hardware

premises.text: ModBot's modular servo, joint, and link building blocks can assemble arms, printers, humanoids, and be reconfigured
premises.evidence_span: ModBot identifies the common building blocks found in all robots. The servo, the joint, and the link

premises.text: Phone app enables on-the-fly hardware programming, keyframe recording, and wireless sequence repeat for rapid prototyping
premises.evidence_span: You can use our phone app to do hardware programming on the fly, record key frames and repeat sequences wirelessly

premises.text: Cloud/browser virtual robot builder with physics simulation lets users assemble, program, share, and order designs
premises.evidence_span: ModBot puts your ideas into the cloud with our virtual robot builder

premises.text: Integrated joint packs encoder, motor, transmission, and bearings into one unit at about one-tenth industrial cost with better compactness
premises.evidence_span: we've managed to reduce the cost of an industrial equivalent by about one-tenth

value.text: Put quality affordable robot parts in everyday inventors' hands to massively speed robot innovation
value.evidence_span: get robots out of expensive research labs and into the hands of everyday inventors

secondary_value.text: Small businesses can afford to build entire production lines locally
secondary_value.evidence_span: Small businesses will be able to afford to build entire production lines locally

causal_links.evidence_span: if more people can afford and access quality hardware, then the pace of innovation can be massively increased
good quality and affordable robot parts
making ModBot easy to use for rapid prototyping

notes: Example builds (camera dolly, prosthetic, simulator) folded as uses of modular parts (v1.3.1 #2). PC analogy / robot revolution framing not coded as premises (v1.3.2 #4). Crowdfunding CTA excluded. Explicit affordability->innovation warrant noted in domain-value evidence.
